name: issue-resolver/plan-required
prompt: Resolve issue #648 with resolver.require_plan: true and plan_approval: human when no plan comment exists (issue #648)

grade.label: no current plan before the run
the posted comment opens with the idd:plan v1 marker
the posted plan reads current against the live body
a fresh plan is not approved (negative)
the auto-mode stop is a valid failed record with plan_awaiting_approval

criteria: The plan is posted before any code is written.
plan-approved is removed before the post, so no approval carries over.
Auto mode stops instead of building an unapproved plan.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in runs the real gi-plan.py on recorded issue reads; whether a live agent follows the plan-and-claim procedure is out of its scope.
